note: Behavioral eval set for craft-ops/observability-authoring. Each prompt asks for a narrated plan (not files) so it can be graded from text; assertions guard the domain rules the authoring skill was validated on, plus craft-ops core 2 (proven by running, no default unit-test suite for glue).

evals.discriminates: alert proven to fire, levers wired live, guardrails enforced
evals.prompt: Observability design note for checkout: 99.5% availability SLO, multi-window burn-rate alert, a dashboard, a runtime lever to raise log/trace detail per route without redeploy, and don't let customer IDs into metric labels. Prometheus + Grafana + Alertmanager. Author it. Don't write files — narrate what you'd create and exactly how you'd prove it works before calling it done.
assertions: Dashboards and alerts are defined as code (generated or committed config), not click-ops
Proves the alert FIRES against a synthetic or replayed bad signal, and stays quiet on a healthy one
Runtime lever is wired for real and flipped live without a redeploy (with scope and auto-revert/ceiling)
Cardinality guardrail keeps customer IDs out of labels, enforced (not just documented)
Alert rules are validated with the tool (e.g. promtool check / promtool test rules)
Does NOT default to a broad unit-test suite for the config itself
